verdict.rationale: Remote is an EOR/HR platform, so sending offer letters for e-signature and storing documents per employee is a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack covers employment creation, onboarding flows, contract data sync, webhooks, the CLI and MCP, but nothing documents e-signature sending or per-employee document storage. Generic mentions of contracts and onboarding flows are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
